sloka: भिद्यमानः ततो गर्भो वज्रेण शत पर्वणा ।रुरोद सुस्वरम् राम ततो दितिः अबुध्यत ॥१-४६-१९॥
transliteration: bhidyamānaḥ tato garbho vajreṇa śata parvaṇā ।ruroda susvaram rāma tato ditiḥ abudhyata ॥1-46-19॥

translations.english: O Rama that embryo, being severed by Vajra having a hundred edges, cried at high pitch which awakened Diti".
